I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I can't confirm the 8 April renewal date, so I treated it as unverified and didn't record it anywhere.

- **What I checked:** #central-team and the public Central team files, all of which Pree can see herself. None of them gives a renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. No Brackenwater account files show up in the files available to me.
- **What I told her:** Nothing I can see backs up 8 April or rules it out. I didn't add it to any record, calendar or digest. I'll log it once the customer confirms it in writing, or once whoever owns the account confirms it from the contract.

I didn't use `search_messages`, and I didn't look at channels Pree isn't in. No approval was needed, since a renewal date isn't a finance figure and nothing was sent outside the company.
